purpose: Repair Djinni TPR transfer before any original-prompt GRPO comparison. No training release.

legacy_data_and_evaluation.prompt: original baseline binary hire/reject; no audit rubric added to model input
legacy_data_and_evaluation.current_runtime_callback: legacy implementation unchanged and not released by this freeze

source.rjdb_role: separate diagnostic only; no primary TPR credit
source.eligibility: Known training/validation, historical votes, benchmark candidates/jobs, development cases and normalized duplicate CVs excluded; see source evidence.

near_duplicate_screen.algorithm: NFKC/casefold/whitespace normalized CV token 5-gram Jaccard >=0.8, plus containment >=0.9 when shorter has >=50 tokens; exact duplicate check for shorter texts
near_duplicate_screen.action: Exclude any connected component touching known exposure; retain minimum intake-hash candidate from each remaining component. Apply before annotation, log all removals; no replacement within first batch. Supplemental batches follow frozen global order.

partition.algorithm: SHA256 UTF8 salt+candidate_id interpreted as unsigned big-endian integer; <2**255 monitor, otherwise validation
partition.shared_jobs: Report shared and training-seen jobs; mandatory job-cluster sensitivity. No claim of job-independent validation.

intake.selection: ascending intake hash; one original pair per candidate; never rank by old label or model scores
intake.continue_rule: Only before trained-arm scores: finish each full batch, label all eligible cases, score SFT-v3 only, stop after first complete batch meeting both banks structural support gates including bootstrap empty-cell preflight; at cap unmet -> no release. Post-arm CI precision never determines supplementation.
intake.retain: All resolved hire and reject cases; never discard an inconvenient resolved label

annotation.date_rule: Use a CV-stated or documented record as-of date. Cache/download mtime 2026-10-20 is not a CV observation date. Without a valid cutoff an open-ended interval cannot establish duration.
annotation.procedure: Freeze JD-only rubric before showing CV; two independent blinded evidence ledgers, exact quotes/counts/policy checks. Export binary label only if both valid ledgers agree on hire/reject; review/disagreement -> label null. No automatic majority/forced reject. Reviewer identities and serving versions must be logged before annotation starts.

estimator.parent_score: fresh SFT-v3 op-margin-v2 on exact final prompts; no k8/k32 rate bin substitution
estimator.row_grid: exact frozen 68 attributed variants per pair; one attribute-free control reported separately
estimator.target_weights: exact benchmark counts conditional on released GPT-4o label in monitor_v2_target_weights.json; no rounded weights
estimator.cell_mean: equal row mean of current hire indicator minus parent indicator in the declared label/bin/group/condition cell; full grids and one pair/candidate prevent uneven row counts per pair
estimator.missing_cell: unsupported; never zero-fill or renormalize supported target mass
estimator.parent_only_weight_lock: After resolved labels, fixed row grid and fresh SFT margins exist: freeze row order, cell counts, row weights W_cell/n_cell and prompt SHA before any trained-arm scores.
estimator.loss_gain: Report separately; neither replaces net TPR change.

label_bridge.scope: all 450 original benchmark pairs, blinded JD/CV under same protocol, no new arm queries
outputs: hire/reject/unresolved by legacy label and parent bin
parent TPR under each label definition
label_bridge.use: Legacy GPT-4o TPR is the unchanged guardrail target. Unified-label resolved-set TPR is separate. No semantic equivalence is assumed from both being binary. Existing arm-score validation must pass for legacy target; low bridge coverage or material disagreement blocks a claim that this monitor measures the same construct, pending a separately versioned target decision.

support_gates.bootstrap_structure_preflight: Before trained-arm scores, simulate all 40 frozen check-index candidate resampling seeds on parent-only cell memberships; every one of the 65536 draws per index must retain every positive-weight cell in both banks. Any empty cell fails structural support; supplement using the fixed intake order, never trained-arm outcomes.
support_gates.insufficient_action: do not reveal trained-arm results; supplement by fixed batch order, otherwise block
support_gates.precision_gate_after_scores: CI half-width evaluated on the actual delta and transfer error after blinded one-time validation; failure cannot be fixed by resampling on those results

validation.false_alarm_rule: Under the frozen conservative runtime rule every predeclared safe arm with actual drop <8pp must also be reported; at exactly8pp a stop is intended. Any false stop blocks routine deployment of this rule until a new preregistration, not posthoc threshold tuning
validation.new_validation_bank: Estimate independently with same frozen target weights; compare to monitor and unchanged legacy benchmark. Existing benchmark arms are development stress evidence, not a new unseen-model test.
validation.fpr: diagnostic, no new automatic FPR threshold
validation.failure: No training. This validation is spent; further changes require another untouched confirmation cohort.

alerts.signed_delta: current TPR minus SFT-v3 TPR, in probability units
alerts.conservative_stop: save and stop if signed-delta lower bound <= -0.08; equivalently plausible drop upper bound >=8pp

uncertainty.method: candidate-cluster percentile bootstrap, fixed target weights, recompute all cell means
uncertainty.empty_positive_weight_cell_in_any_replic: save and stop for insufficient support; do not discard replicate
uncertainty.sampling: whole candidates with all rows within the frozen bank; no outcome-stratified recruitment
uncertainty.coverage_claim: approximate bootstrap rule; Bonferroni only applies if component intervals cover correctly. Not a demonstrated 95% trajectory guarantee.

alerts.integrity_failure: save and stop on nonfinite margins, missing rows/cells, prompt/model/data hash mismatch, failed serving sync or unavailable scorer
alerts.resume: persist and verify parent model hash, prompt order/hash, labels/weights, config hash and accumulated check index; never validate by length alone
alerts.budget_exhausted: save and stop before an unbudgeted 41st check
alerts.transport_bias: validate separately against fixed legacy benchmark and new validation bank; bootstrap does not bound label/transport bias
alerts.between_check_risk: No guarantee of catching a 10pp breach between two checks

pending_second_lock: JD rubrics and two blinded valid ledgers per resolved label
label bridge and explicit resolution of remaining construct differences
fresh SFT-v3 margins on frozen rows
